The '''Garis sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The sector included the [[Gazzari system/Legends|Gazzari system]], the [[Omwat system/Legends|Omwat system]] and the [[Roccus system]]. The Garis sector also included [[Harlequin Station]] and [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]]' [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|Twin Sun Station]]. Harlequin Station was located in deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]], while the latter station was in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above [[Roccus]].
